<!--
Results report of hcesfort (use_report_template()). Render the data
readiness report first: this report shows only the sections its verdict
enables. Inputs and choices live in _inputs.R, shared with readiness.qmd;
do not set them here. Edit the title above and write your own text between
the exhibits; guidance for the analyst stays in comments like this one and
never reaches the output. The report states results: interpreting them is
the analyst's work.
Design: docs/design-reports-v2.md of the package, section 7.
-->

```{r setup}
writeLines(utils::capture.output(utils::sessionInfo()),
           "results-sessionInfo.txt")
source("_inputs.R", local = TRUE)
source("_chain.R", local = TRUE)
source("_tables.R", local = TRUE)
source("_figures.R", local = TRUE)
source("_results.R", local = TRUE)
lev <- 100 * choices$level
small_note <- paste0(
  "A dash marks a cell with fewer than ", choices$min_n, " households. ",
  "Precision: a wide interval has a half-width above ",
  pct(choices$max_half_width, 0), " points; its point is drawn hollow."
)
```

```{r stop-if-not-ready, results = "asis"}
if (!ready) {
  cat("An essential input is absent: see the data readiness report.\n")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

## Which households acquire each vehicle?

```{r coverage, results = "asis"}
if (!enabled("coverage")) {
  cat(disabled_sentence("coverage"), "\n")
} else {
  tables$coverage_vehicle <- coverage_table("vehicle")
  show_exhibit("coverage_vehicle", paste0(
    "Households that acquired each vehicle in the reference period, % of ",
    "households, with its ", lev, "% interval. ", small_note
  ), fig_interval(tables$coverage_vehicle, "acquired", "vehicle",
                  xlab = "Households acquiring (%)", ylab = "Vehicle"))
  tables$coverage_group <- coverage_table(c("group", "combined"))
  show_exhibit("coverage_group", paste0(
    "Households that acquired at least one vehicle of each group, % of ",
    "households, with its ", lev, "% interval. Groups: ", group_note()
  ), fig_interval(tables$coverage_group, "acquired", "vehicle_group",
                  xlab = "Households acquiring (%)", ylab = "Vehicle group"))
}
```

```{r quantity, results = "asis"}
if (!enabled("quantity")) {
  cat(disabled_sentence("quantity"), "\n")
} else {
  tables$quantity <- quantity_table()
  show_exhibit("quantity", paste0(
    "Quantity acquired among the households that acquire each vehicle: ",
    "median grams per adult female equivalent (AFE) per day, with its ",
    lev, "% interval."
  ), fig_interval(tables$quantity, "median_g", "vehicle",
                  xlab = "Median g per AFE per day", ylab = "Vehicle"))
}
```

```{r no-vehicle, results = "asis"}
if (enabled("coverage")) {
  tables$no_vehicle <- no_vehicle_table()
  show_exhibit("no_vehicle", paste0(
    "Households that acquired no vehicle, % of households, with its ",
    lev, "% interval."
  ), fig_interval(tables$no_vehicle, "none", "population",
                  xlab = "Households acquiring no vehicle (%)",
                  ylab = "Population"))
  for (d in choices$domains) {
    if (!enabled("coverage", d)) {
      cat(disabled_sentence("coverage", d), "\n\n")
      next
    }
    id <- paste0("no_vehicle_", d)
    tables[[id]] <- no_vehicle_table(d)
    show_exhibit(id, paste0(
      "Households that acquired no vehicle by ", tolower(lab(d, "domain")),
      ", % of households, with its ", lev, "% interval. ", small_note
    ), fig_interval(tables[[id]], "none", "domain_value",
                    xlab = "Households acquiring no vehicle (%)",
                    ylab = as.character(lab(d, "domain"))),
    headers = value_header(d))
  }
}
```

## Which nutrients are at risk without fortification?

```{r risk, results = "asis"}
if (!enabled("risk")) {
  cat(disabled_sentence("risk"), "\n")
} else {
  tables$risk <- risk_table()
  show_exhibit("risk", paste0(
    "Households whose apparent intake per AFE is below the requirement, ",
    "without fortification, % of households, with its ", lev,
    "% interval. Method: ", method_note(), " ", small_note
  ), fig_interval(tables$risk, "inadequate", "nutrient",
                  xlab = "Inadequate intake (%)", ylab = "Nutrient"))
  for (d in choices$domains) {
    if (!enabled("risk", d)) {
      cat(disabled_sentence("risk", d), "\n\n")
      next
    }
    id <- paste0("risk_", d)
    tables[[id]] <- risk_table(d)
    show_exhibit(id, paste0(
      "Inadequate intake without fortification by ",
      tolower(lab(d, "domain")), ", % of households, with its ", lev,
      "% interval. ", small_note
    ), fig_interval(tables[[id]], "inadequate", "domain_value",
                    xlab = "Inadequate intake (%)",
                    ylab = as.character(lab(d, "domain")),
                    facet = "nutrient"),
    headers = value_header(d))
  }
}
```

## What would each fortification scenario change?

```{r scenarios, results = "asis"}
if (!enabled("scenarios")) {
  cat(disabled_sentence("scenarios"), "\n")
} else {
  tables$scenarios <- scenario_table()
  show_exhibit("scenarios", paste(
    "Fortification scenarios: vehicle, nutrient, level in mg of nutrient",
    "per kg of vehicle (compounds converted), form, share of the vehicle",
    "fortified (compliance) and source."
  ))
  eff <- effects_table()
  for (n in choices$nutrients) {
    id <- paste0("effects_", n)
    tables[[id]] <- eff[eff$nutrient %in% as.character(lab(n, "nutrient")), ]
    if (nrow(tables[[id]]) == 0) next
    show_exhibit(id, paste0(
      as.character(lab(n, "nutrient")), ": inadequate intake under each ",
      "scenario and under the scenario it is compared with, % of ",
      "households, and their paired difference in percentage points with ",
      "its ", lev, "% interval. ", small_note
    ), fig_dumbbell(tables[[id]], "from", "to", "scenario",
                    xlab = "Inadequate intake (%)", ylab = "Scenario"))
    cat("In the figure, the hollow point is the scenario compared with and",
        "the filled point the scenario; the interval of the difference is",
        "in the table above.\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r above-ul, results = "asis"}
if (enabled("scenarios")) {
  ul <- above_ul_estimates()
  tables$ul_scope <- ul_scope_table(ul)
  show_exhibit("ul_scope", paste(
    "Intake compared with the tolerable upper intake level (UL) of each",
    "nutrient, and the direction of the bias of that comparison."
  ))
  tables$above_ul <- above_ul_table(ul)
  show_exhibit("above_ul", paste0(
    "Households above the UL under each scenario, % of households, with ",
    "its ", lev, "% interval. The UL of adults is applied to the intake ",
    "per AFE. ", small_note
  ))
}
```

```{r equity, results = "asis"}
if (enabled("scenarios")) {
  for (d in choices$equity_domains) {
    if (!enabled("scenarios", d)) {
      cat(disabled_sentence("scenarios", d), "\n\n")
      next
    }
    eff <- effects_table(d)
    for (n in choices$nutrients) {
      id <- paste0("equity_", n, "_", d)
      tables[[id]] <- eff[eff$nutrient %in% as.character(lab(n, "nutrient")), ]
      if (nrow(tables[[id]]) == 0) next
      show_exhibit(id, paste0(
        as.character(lab(n, "nutrient")), " by ", tolower(lab(d, "domain")),
        ": inadequate intake under each scenario and under the scenario ",
        "it is compared with, % of households, and their paired ",
        "difference in percentage points with its ", lev, "% interval. ",
        small_note
      ), fig_dumbbell(tables[[id]], "from", "to", "domain_value",
                      xlab = "Inadequate intake (%)",
                      ylab = as.character(lab(d, "domain")),
                      facet = "scenario"),
      headers = value_header(d))
    }
  }
}
```

## Where does each nutrient come from?

```{r food-groups, results = "asis"}
if (!enabled("food_groups")) {
  cat(disabled_sentence("food_groups"), "\n")
} else {
  tables$food_groups <- food_group_table()
  fg <- tables$food_groups
  unclassified <- as.character(lab("unclassified", "food_group"))
  none <- fg[fg$food_group %in% unclassified, ]
  show_exhibit("food_groups", paste0(
    "Share of the apparent intake of each nutrient supplied by each food ",
    "group, without fortification, %, with its ", lev, "% interval. A ",
    "share of 0 has no interval. Foods with no group assigned: ",
    paste0(none$nutrient, " ", none$share, "%", collapse = "; "), "."
  ), fig_interval(fg, "share", "food_group", xlab = "Share of intake (%)",
                  ylab = "Food group", facet = "nutrient"))
}
```

## Technical note

```{r reference, results = "asis"}
tables$reference <- reference_table()
show_exhibit("reference", paste(
  "Estimated average requirement (EAR) and tolerable upper intake level",
  "(UL) used, with their source."
))
if (enabled("risk") && "iron" %in% choices$nutrients) {
  tables$iron_sensitivity <- iron_sensitivity_table()
  show_exhibit("iron_sensitivity", paste0(
    "Inadequate intake of iron without fortification under each iron ",
    "bioavailability, % of households, with its ", lev, "% interval. The ",
    "results above use ", pct(choices$iron_bioavailability, 0), "%."
  ))
}
```

variables used, the records linked to the composition table, the
plausibility of the apparent energy and the decisions taken with the data.
